facts.f: Largest allocation: School Education Rs 32,308 crore
Health Rs 19,306 crore, 4th largest
AP Wealth Fund Rs 100 cr seed; free power 200/500 units; cybercrime PS per district

new.s:
Consider the following announcements in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27:
1. An AP Wealth Fund with a seed of Rs 100 crore.
2. Free power of 500 units for handloom weavers and 200 units for powerloom weavers.
3. A cybercrime police station in every district.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 reverses the units: handloom weavers get 200 units and powerloom weavers 500 units, from 1 April 2026. So options with statement 2 (A, C, D) are wrong.
new.tq: Weavers' free power: handloom 200, powerloom 500 units.

new.s: In the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27, the allocation for Health was about Rs 19,306 crore. Which statement about it is correct?
o: It was the largest departmental allocation
It was the fourth largest, at about 5.81% of the Budget
It was smaller than the AP Wealth Fund seed
It was larger than School Education's Rs 32,308 crore
new.x: Health got Rs 19,306 crore (+9.5%), 5.81% of the Budget and the 4th largest. School Education (Rs 32,308 crore) was the largest, so A and D are wrong; the AP Wealth Fund seed is only Rs 100 crore, so C is wrong.
